species_or_preparation: Perillae Herba is identified as a leaf of Perilla frutescens; the experiment administered purchased purified rosmarinic acid dissolved in saline, not rosemary or whole Perilla.
model_and_observed_outcome: Male ddY mice; 1, 2, or 4 mg/kg i.p. for 7 or 14 days; forced-swim immobility fell dose/time dependently, with no open-field locomotor change. This is an animal model, not clinical depression.
clinical_fit_and_access_limit: Complete 5-page J-STAGE article; compound and species differ from fresh rosemary; no human depression endpoint.

species_or_preparation: Isolated rosmarinic acid (RA); source plant not specified in the abstract and no rosemary food preparation tested.
model_and_observed_outcome: Sprague-Dawley rats underwent 21-day chronic unpredictable stress; RA was given for 14 days during the last stress week, 10 mg/kg daily, and the abstract reports reversal of depressive-like behavior and restoration of hippocampal pERK1/2 and BDNF. Astrocyte culture: 20 microgram/mL RA increased pERK1/2 and BDNF. Animal/cell study, not clinical.
clinical_fit_and_access_limit: Official PubMed abstract only; publisher body remains gated; administration route and exact behavioral metrics cannot be verified here.

species_or_preparation: Rosmarinus officinalis polyphenols plus luteolin, carnosic acid, and rosmarinic acid; abstract does not expose the culinary preparation, extraction protocol, or doses.
model_and_observed_outcome: Tail-suspension test in ICR mice plus PC12 cell model; abstract reports reduced immobility and changes in dopamine, norepinephrine, serotonin, acetylcholine and related gene expression. No human depression outcome.
clinical_fit_and_access_limit: Species-specific closest citation, but only NBRP/PubMed abstract is public in reviewed routes; Elsevier ScienceDirect article route returned HTTP 403 and no full author copy was located.

species_or_preparation: Purified rosmarinic acid and caffeic acid, not a food or rosemary preparation.
model_and_observed_outcome: In mice, i.p. RA 2 mg/kg and caffeic acid 4 mg/kg reduced forced-swim immobility; spontaneous motor activity was unchanged at behaviorally active doses. No clinical outcome.
clinical_fit_and_access_limit: Official PubMed abstract only; publisher full body not retrieved; isolated compound and animal model, no human depression measure.

species_or_preparation: Leaf water extract/fractions of Perilla frutescens var. acuta (Perillae Herba); oral water extract and 50%/30% methanol-derived fractions were studied, alongside RA given orally or i.p. No rosemary.
model_and_observed_outcome: Mice forced-swim test: water extract and active fractions, and RA, reduced immobility; another Perilla species with low RA did not. No clinical outcome.
clinical_fit_and_access_limit: Official PubMed/author abstract also indexed by POPLINE; original Japanese journal body not recovered; distinct species and medicinal extract, no human results.
